title: 第二十一章 黏人三宝第二十二章 发小重逢
lines: 第二十一章：黏人三宝
林昆还是留下来帮章小雅搬行李，在章小雅的行李上，他看到了一份当日的晨报，醒目的标题吸引了他的注意，上面写着：市中心警察局局长畏惧自杀……
林昆马上想到昨天刚见过的黄光明，顿时心生愧疚：“这事跟我有关啊。”
可再一想到黄光明那张肥而油腻的脸，不知道涂了多少民脂民膏闪闪发亮，说话的时候总是一副阿谀奉承的歪风邪气，这种人死了倒也算是为民除害了。
一念至此，他心里那一丢丢的愧疚顿时烟消云散，同时一阵骄傲之气搪满胸腔，大有一股站到房顶上向全世界宣布‘老子是反腐先锋’的冲动。
章小雅的行李不多，林昆来回搬了两趟就搬完了，林昆搬行李的时候章小雅也没闲着，这小妮子总能找到点东西拿着跟在林昆的身后，微微颔首脸颊粉红的模样，像是个乖顺的妹子，又仿佛娇滴滴的小媳妇儿，每次抬起头看面前挺拔的脊背的时候，脸上都是一阵陶醉的表情。
显然，这小妮子以不可抗拒的花痴劲头，彻底坠入了单相思的漩涡。
行李搬完了，林昆也要回家了，章小雅这时羞嗒嗒的跑过来，就好像是初中小女生第一次谈爱时不好意思开口的问道：“林大哥，下午你有空么？”
林昆不知道这小妮子想干嘛，但他果断的拒绝：“没空！”原因很简单，虽然他在漠北那个女人罕见的地方服役了八年，但不代表他情商低，从一走进这小院章小雅满脸惊喜的一刻起，他就知道自己被盯上了。
章小雅脸蛋白皙漂亮，身材又那么的窈窕，放在学校里即便不是校花，至少也是个系花级别的，按说被这样的美女‘盯’上了，身为男人的林昆应该高兴才是，干嘛搞的这么紧张决绝仿佛人家女孩是妖精变的似的？
这里面有林昆的苦衷，不管怎么说，他现在是小楚澄名义上的爸爸，楚静瑶名义上的老公，男人沾花惹草的那点勾勾心思他不是没有，但不能把这心思用在了章小雅身上，兔子还不吃窝边草呢，后院起火了怎么办？
章小雅失落了一声，站在那儿可怜巴巴的，林昆心里想着赶紧脱身，抬起脚就往门外迈，哪知这时章小雅突然满血复活一般，两只眼睛闪闪发亮起来，紧追过来一脸灿烂的笑道：“没关系林大哥，下午我有空。”
看着章小雅一脸灿烂的微笑，像一朵迎风招展的雏菊花，林昆表情发愣，一时间没反应过来，随即问道：“妹子，你有空跟我有什么关系？”
章小雅天真的微笑道：“当然有关系啦，不管林大哥下午干什么，我都有时间陪着你啊。林大哥，你不用不好意思，就当是我报答你帮我搬家啦！”
林昆两眼一黑，耳边仿佛飘过三声乌鸦的叫声——哇哇哇……他苦着一张脸，嘴角颤抖的道：“妹子，你也别客气，我学雷锋做好事，你不用报答我。”
章小雅微笑着理直气壮的说：“那不行，我爷爷从小就教我，欠什么都不能欠人情。”
林昆的耳边又飘过了三声乌鸦叫，他此时此刻的心情正应了那句诗——枯藤，老树，昏鸦……他现在真想一只脚迈出门外，像一道烟一样消失。
章小雅依旧一副天真的笑容，嘴上却是又见血封喉的补上一句：“林大哥，你下午要是不方便就算了，等晚上我做些好吃的送给你，就当是报答喽。”说完，小妮子眨着一双水灵灵的大眼睛，频频闪烁着卖萌的秋波。
章小雅表面上笑容单纯天真，心里却是偷偷的狡黠一笑，“网上说的还真没错，女人黏住男人的三大法宝——装傻，卖萌，扮天真，嘻嘻。”
百凤门舞厅三楼的大办公室里，阿东站在蒋叶丽的面前，蒋叶丽手里夹着一根细烟，另一只手端着一杯红酒，红酒在窗外透进来的阳光照射下色彩艳丽，像年轻姑娘妖冶的唇妆，又仿佛醮染开了的血汁。
阿东一身西装腰杆挺直，他是一个无论春夏秋冬都是一身西装的男人，穿西装对于他来说已经无关冷热，而是一种生活的习惯跟做事的态度。
阿东汇报完了今天的事情，其中有关于林昆的，蒋叶丽听完之后略微沉吟，嘴角轻轻一笑，道：“看来，这个小伙子果真是一条过江龙啊！”
阿东立正不出声，等着蒋叶丽继续说。蒋叶丽喝了一口红酒，抽了一口烟，阳光照在她的脸上映起一片红晕，这时的她是最迷人的，她朱唇轻启接着说：“眼下最重要的是，黄光明突然死了，接任他职务的应该会从四大城区的警局里直接抽调，这是中港市境界历来的规矩，要是被抽调到中心警察局任局长的是咱们南城区的张延，百凤门就危险了。”
content_en:
Chapter 21: Three Treasures of Stickiness
Lin Kun stayed to help Zhang Xiaoya carry his luggage. On Zhang Xiaoya's luggage, he saw a copy of that day's morning newspaper. The eye-catching headline attracted his attention. It read: The chief of the downtown police station is afraid of committing suicide...
Lin Kun immediately thought of Huang Guangming, whom he had just met yesterday, and suddenly felt guilty: "This matter has something to do with me."
But when I think of Huang Guangming's fat and greasy face, it shines brightly after being smeared with people's grease. When he speaks, he always has a flattering and evil demeanor. When such a person dies, he can be regarded as eliminating harm for the people.
As soon as he thought of this, the trace of guilt in his heart immediately disappeared. At the same time, a burst of pride filled his chest, and he had the urge to stand on the roof and announce to the world, 'I am a pioneer in anti-corruption.'
Zhang Xiaoya didn't have much luggage, so Lin Kun moved it back and forth twice before finishing it. Zhang Xiaoya was not idle when Lin Kun was moving the luggage. This little girl always found something and followed behind Lin Kun, nodding slightly with pink cheeks, like an obedient girl, but also like a delicate little daughter-in-law. Every time she raised her head to look at the straight back in front of her, there was an intoxicated expression on her face.
Obviously, this little girl has completely fallen into the whirlpool of unrequited love with her irresistible lust.
After the luggage was moved, Lin Kun was about to go home. At this moment, Zhang Xiaoya ran over shyly, as if a junior high school girl was embarrassed to ask when she was having sex for the first time: "Brother Lin, are you free this afternoon?"
Lin Kun didn't know what this little girl wanted to do, but he decisively refused: "No time!" The reason was simple. Although he had served for eight years in Mobei, a place where women were rare, it did not mean that he had low emotional intelligence. From the moment he walked into the small courtyard and Zhang Xiaoya's face was filled with surprise, he knew that he was being targeted.
Zhang Xiaoya has a pretty face and a slim figure. Even if she is not a school beauty, she is at least a department beauty. As a man, Lin Kun should be happy to be 'targeted' by such a beauty. Why is he so nervous and decisive, as if the girl is a fairy?
There is Lin Kun's difficulty in this. After all, he is now Xiao Chucheng's nominal father and Chu Jingyao's nominal husband. It's not like he doesn't have some thoughts about men flirting with women, but he can't use these thoughts on Zhang Xiaoya. The rabbit won't eat the grass beside the nest. What should I do if there's a fire in the backyard?
"Oh..."
Zhang Xiaoya let out a sound of disappointment and stood there pitifully. Lin Kun thought in his mind to get away quickly, raised his feet and walked out the door. Unexpectedly, Zhang Xiaoya suddenly came to life with full blood, her eyes sparkled, and she chased after him with a bright smile on her face: "It's okay, Brother Lin, I'm free in the afternoon."
Seeing Zhang Xiaoya's bright smile, like a daisy flower blowing in the wind, Lin Kun looked dazed and didn't react for a moment, then asked: "Sister, what do you have to do with me when you have time?"
Zhang Xiaoya smiled innocently and said: "Of course it doesn't matter. No matter what Brother Lin does in the afternoon, I will always have time to accompany you. Brother Lin, don't be embarrassed, just think of it as my repayment for helping me move!"
Lin Kun's eyes darkened, and three crows seemed to float in his ears - wow wow wow... He made a bitter face and said with trembling lips: "Sister, you're welcome, I'll do good deeds like Lei Feng, you don't have to repay me."
Zhang Xiaoya smiled and said confidently: "That won't work. My grandfather taught me since I was a child that I can't owe anyone anything."
Three more crows floated past Lin Kun's ears. His mood at this moment was exactly in line with that poem - withered vines, old trees, dusky crows... He really wanted to step out of the door with one foot and disappear like a wisp of smoke.
Zhang Xiaoya still had an innocent smile, but her mouth was filled with blood as she added: "Brother Lin, if it's inconvenient for you this afternoon, forget it, I'll make some delicious food for you in the evening, just as repayment." After saying that, Xiao Nizi blinked her big, watery eyes, flashing her cute eyes frequently.
Lin Kun: "..."
Zhang Xiaoya smiled innocently and innocently on the surface, but secretly smiled slyly in her heart, "It's true what the Internet says, there are three magic weapons for women to stick to men - pretending to be stupid, acting cute, acting innocent, hehe."
In the large office on the third floor of the Baifengmen Ballroom, A Dong stood in front of Jiang Yeli. Jiang Yeli held a thin cigarette in his hand and a glass of red wine in the other hand. The red wine was brightly colored under the sunlight coming in from the window, like the voluptuous lip makeup of a young girl, and like the blood stained by it.
A Dong wears a suit with his waist straight. He is a man who always wears a suit regardless of spring, summer, autumn or winter. For him, wearing a suit has nothing to do with whether he is hot or cold, but a habit of life and an attitude towards doing things.
After Adong finished reporting today's events, including the one about Lin Kun, Jiang Yeli pondered a little, smiled softly, and said: "It seems that this young man is really a dragon crossing the river!"
A Dong stood at attention and said nothing, waiting for Jiang Yeli to continue. Jiang Yeli took a sip of red wine and smoked a cigarette. The sunlight cast a blush on her face. She was the most charming at this time. She opened her red lips and continued: "The most important thing right now is that Huang Guangming died suddenly. Then The person appointed to his position should be directly transferred from the police stations of the four major urban areas. This is the traditional rule in the realm of China and Hong Kong. If the person transferred to the Central Police Station as the chief is our Nancheng District Zhang Yan, Baifengmen will be in danger. "
